gaps.source_claim: 『廉贞天相』与空劫同度，则难以积财；同页另有字面异常“有是非词不达意讼”及替代条件范围未决。
gaps.reason: The clear clause “『廉贞天相』与空劫同度，则难以积财” is now represented. The printed page image visibly reads “有是非词不达意讼”; the sequence is semantically anomalous, so no intended correction is inferred. The scope of the “或虽表面风光，其实内在空虚，寅吃卯粮” alternative relative to the preceding 刑煞 modifier remains unresolved.
unresolved_claims: The printed sequence “有是非词不达意讼” is legible but semantically anomalous. Its intended reading cannot be established from this source alone; preserve the literal wording and do not emend it to “有是非词讼” or another phrase.
The “表面风光 / 内在空虚 / 寅吃卯粮” alternative is not canonically promoted because its condition scope relative to the preceding 刑煞 modifier has not been resolved.
gaps.resolution_requirements: Retain the partial disposition. Resolve only from an authoritative alternate edition or source-owner decision; do not silently emend.

gaps.source_claim: 太阴化禄冲会文曲化忌，则主被绰或遗失。
gaps.reason: The printed page image confirms the literal glyph 绰 in 被绰或遗失, but the phrase is semantically anomalous. The intended reading cannot be established from this source alone.
gaps.resolution_requirements: Preserve the literal source text and mark its intended meaning unresolved. Do not silently replace 绰 with a plausible character or promote an emended reading.

gaps.resolution_requirements: Retain 卯本太阴 literally. Do not emend it to 卯宫太阴 or another phrase without independent source evidence.

gaps.source_claim: 其实(即社会地位)亦由富而来

gaps.resolution_requirements: Preserve the printed literal and do not silently emend 实 to 贵 or another character without independent source evidence. The W06-532 promoted target is limited to the clear night/day birth hierarchy; this subclause remains unnormalized.

gaps.source_claim: 不化忌，但成『风流采杖』之局者，则主投机致祸，或经营半偏及偏门行业而致身败名裂。
